subject: Request: No-PO path for 45-day mini-pilot with NimbusForge
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, orla@nimbusforge.com
Cc: finance@nimbusforge.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: No-PO path for 45-day mini-pilot with NimbusForge

Hi team / Orla,

Following up from yesterday's intro call — NimbusForge would like to run a 45-day exploratory pilot (up to $4,500 total) to evaluate LLM-powered telemetry enrichment against our inference runtime. They asked if we can accept invoice-only terms for the trial rather than requiring a formal PO.

Summary:
- Pilot value: ~$4,500 (single invoice covering the trial)
- Timeline: Dec 1 — Jan 15 (45 days)
- Deliverables: integration support, 1x model variant, up to 100k tokens of test traffic (see attached SOW)

Ask: Can procurement/legal sign off on an exception so NimbusForge can onboard without a PO for this mini-pilot? If not, what paperwork would unblock it quickly (PO waiver, vendor terms, or a short purchase order)?

I've attached the Pilot_SOW.pdf the vendor sent. Orla — can you attach the vendor W-9 and confirm billing email?

Next steps I'd propose:
1) Procurement advises whether an invoice-only path is acceptable under our small vendor exception.
2) If yes, Karthik to confirm required form set and payment terms (net30/net45).
3) If no, Naomi to advise minimal legal exceptions (counterparty risk) and whether a PO waiver can be applied.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call to expedite.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0182
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Pilot_SOW.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: orla@nimbusforge.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: No-PO path for 45-day mini-pilot with NimbusForge

Thanks Jordan — quick operational note from CS/ops side:

If procurement allows invoice-only, ops can onboard NimbusForge in our vendor portal under "Invoice-Only" with a short intake: contact, remit-to, tax id, and a signed SOW. We do require a billing contact and a valid invoice format (line items matching the SOW).

Potential friction: accounting prefers PO-backed invoices for vendors that will be recurring. For a one-off pilot under $5k we usually take invoice-only if procurement/legal sign off.

Orla — can you confirm billing email and whether NimbusForge can accept Net30 on a single invoice? Also attaching an internal checklist for invoice-only onboardings in case helpful.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Orla Byrne <orla@nimbusforge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: finance@nimbusforge.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: No-PO path for 45-day mini-pilot with NimbusForge

Hi Jordan / team,

Thanks — we can confirm:
- Billing email: finance@nimbusforge.com
- Invoice cadence: single invoice at pilot completion (we can split mid-pilot if you prefer)
- Payment terms: Net30 is fine for us

I've attached Nimbus_W9.pdf and a short payment contact form. If Redwood needs a purchase order, we can accept it, but for speed we'd prefer invoice-only for this initial engagement.

Let us know what paperwork you need on our end and we'll return it today.

Best,
Orla Byrne
Head of Finance, NimbusForge
orla@nimbusforge.com
Attachment: Nimbus_W9.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: No-PO path for 45-day mini-pilot with NimbusForge

Jordan / Monica — thanks for the context. Procurement's stance:

- We can approve invoice-only onboarding for vendors where the total engagement is under $7,000 and counterparty risk is low.
- Required conditions: signed SOW referencing the pilot scope, vendor W-9 on file, and a completed PO_Waiver_Form for recordkeeping.
- Payment terms: we prefer Net30. If finance requests Net45, procurement will flag accordingly but it's usually fine for small pilots.

Attached is the PO_Waiver_Form.docx — ask NimbusForge to sign and return, and Naomi please confirm whether legal wants any additional language in the SOW referencing data handling or IP for this trial. Once the waiver and W-9 are in our system, ops can do the invoice-only onboarding and finance will process payment via standard AP.

If anyone prefers, we can apply an internal exception code so this doesn't require a full PO issuance. That reduces friction and keeps ledger entries tidy.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: PO_Waiver_Form.docx

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Orla Byrne <orla@nimbusforge.com>, finance@nimbusforge.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: No-PO path for 45-day mini-pilot with NimbusForge

Thanks all — makes sense and appreciated the quick turnaround. Action items I have captured:

- Orla: please sign and return PO_Waiver_Form.docx and confirm the W-9 (attached earlier) and billing contact (finance@nimbusforge.com).
- Karthik: once waiver is returned I'll upload to vendor portal; procurement to apply internal exception code and confirm Net30 processing.
- Naomi: can you review the SOW for any minimal legal language re: telemetry/data access (recommended single-paragraph addendum would suffice)?
- Monica: prepare ops onboarding checklist and set expected invoice acceptance steps for AP.

If legal and procurement sign off this week we can start the pilot the week of Dec 1. Jordan available for a 15-min sync if helpful.

Regards,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
